title: Page transition layer
purpose: Fixed full-viewport layer for colour-band page transitions. Present in every page's DOM; in every measured transition it never animated (the shared-element arrival is used instead).
retrievalReason: Runtime transition overlay (fixed, opacity 0, z-index -1); in the DOM but never animates in any measured navigation. Not a content unit.

measured.note: fixed/overlay or display:none at 1440; takes no page height
